subjects.name: Mara
subjects.description: Adult woman with short wavy brown hair and an ochre raincoat

place.description: A misty harbour at dusk: a wet wooden pier with a dark railing, dark calm water, a lit ferry and harbour lights in the fog.

shots.description: Mara keeps walking from left to right along the pier in the same side-view tracking shot, framing and light.
shots.screen_direction: Screen left to screen right, as before.
shots.sound: Quiet footsteps on wet planks, water and distant harbour sounds; the sound continues across the cut.

shots.description: Mara keeps walking along the pier at the same steady pace, mid-stride as the shot begins. She is small in the frame at the railing, the pier lamps and fog behind her. Wide static reverse angle; the water moves gently in the foreground. Camera position: Out on the water, looking back at the pier.
shots.screen_direction: Seen from the water, she now moves from screen right to screen left, with the railing on her left between her and the water.
shots.sound: Quiet footsteps on wet planks, water and distant harbour sounds; the sound continues across the cut.
